name: vm-manager-qemu
description: QEMU provider for VM Manager: create and run QEMU virtual machines with graphical (noVNC) and serial consoles.

vmManager.providers.description: QEMU virtual machines managed by VS Code on this machine

walkthroughs.title: Set up QEMU for VM Manager
walkthroughs.description: Install QEMU and let VM Manager find it.

steps.title: Install QEMU
steps.description:
Install QEMU for your platform. On Windows also enable the Windows Hypervisor Platform feature for hardware acceleration.
[Detect QEMU](command:vmm.qemu.detect)

steps.title: Add a QEMU cluster
steps.description:
Add a cluster of type QEMU. VM definitions and disks are stored in a directory you choose.
[Add Cluster](command:vmm.addCluster)
